critical_scope: The critical trace formula requires a regular nongrazing stationary extension. Critical incoming trace may be positive. Its angular derivative bound does not automatically control the minimum with the outgoing trace. The certificate is sufficient, not verified uniformly on the full physical pairing family.
limit_order: Fix B and all epsilon, collar, comparison-width, clock and certificate thresholds before collision limsup; enlarge auxiliary spectral bands only afterwards; B is last. No collision-dependent cutoff or normalization of arithmetic zero classes.
